S.FORM: sawn qinmasan hiya' ga, msaysyaw qu pinmuhi' ta' ttbihi' i~ ini' suqi maniq ru aki' bsyaq skun maha ta' ga, yasa qu mutux ta' 'bgan na cimu' ru tkrawn sa salaw ini' ga t'lusun, maha ni cikuy ga ana tkrawn sa btakan ga blaq uzi. min'aring ta' kbalay qinmasan ga inblayqun gmlaping ru smr'zyut kwara' qu qqmasan ta', ini' pglgi' 'ruraw ru saysyup, ru inblayqun ptr'zyut mku sa bluku'. msinxal qu bnku tbihi' lga rpsan cimu' ru inblayqun qmpul 'mpux ru s'imaw na kakay, ru mutux msbuq qu tbihi'. ru pinkatan cimu' kwara' lga, in_gyutun tkura' mku sa qsahuy na salaw ini' ga t'lusun. ru t'aring qmamas~qmpul ru tkrawn sa salaw lawzi. suqun kwra' lga 'mukan na abaw guquh tay babaw ru 'pxan na btunux ka ppsbuq na ttbihi', ru trhgan 'mumuk na abaw bgazyaw ru bhlan na snyu ka izyat nya' insngya' qu nqwaq na salaw. hmzinas qutux bzyacing lga ana in_gyutun maniq la. izyat nanak tbihi' qu baqun qmamas, ana tawpu' ga blaq qmasan uzi. blaq balay sramat mami' qu qinmasan.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]awn qinma[s|ɕ]an ħijaʔ ɣa m[s|ɕ]aj[s|ɕ]jaw qu pinmuħiʔ taʔ ttβiħiʔ i iniʔ [s|ɕ]uqi maniq ru akiʔ β[s|ɕ]jaq [s|ɕ]kun maħa taʔ ɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu mutux taʔ ʔβɣan na [ʦ|ʨ]imuʔ ru tkrawn [s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]alaw iniʔ ɣa tʔlu[s|ɕ]un maħa ni [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj ɣa ana tkrawn [s|ɕ]a βtakan ɣa βlaq uzi minʔariŋ taʔ kβalaj qinma[s|ɕ]an ɣa inβlajqun ɣmlapiŋ ru [s|ɕ]mrʔzjut kwaraʔ qu qqma[s|ɕ]an taʔ iniʔ pɣlɣiʔ ʔruraw ru [s|ɕ]aj[s|ɕ]jup ru inβlajqun ptrʔzjut mku [s|ɕ]a βlukuʔ m[s|ɕ]inxal qu βnku tβiħiʔ lɣa rp[s|ɕ]an [ʦ|ʨ]imuʔ ru inβlajqun qmpul ʔmpux ru [s|ɕ]ʔimaw na kakaj ru mutux m[s|ɕ]βuq qu tβiħiʔ ru pinkatan [ʦ|ʨ]imuʔ kwaraʔ lɣa inɣjutun tkuraʔ mku [s|ɕ]a q[s|ɕ]aħuj na [s|ɕ]alaw iniʔ ɣa tʔlu[s|ɕ]un ru tʔariŋ qmama[s|ɕ]qmpul ru tkrawn [s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]alaw lawzi [s|ɕ]uqun kwraʔ lɣa ʔmukan na aβaw ɣuquħ taj βaβaw ru ʔpxan na βtunux ka pp[s|ɕ]βuq na ttβiħiʔ ru trħɣan ʔmumuk na aβaw βɣazjaw ru βħlan na [s|ɕ]nju ka izjat njaʔ in[s|ɕ]ŋjaʔ qu nqwaq na [s|ɕ]alaw ħmzina[s|ɕ] qutux βzja[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ lɣa ana inɣjutun maniq la izjat nanak tβiħiʔ qu βaqun qmama[s|ɕ] ana tawpuʔ ɣa βlaq qma[s|ɕ]an uzi βlaq βalaj [s|ɕ]ramat mamiʔ qu qinma[s|ɕ]an
